findings.label: Brief vs. reality on the selector endpoint
findings.detail: The task brief states the selector consumes /api/settings2 (nested station->year->month->day->hours), but the real legacy bundle fetches /api/settings with value=folder and text=name.replace(/_/g,' '). The new app correctly matches the real old app, so no code change is needed; the brief's premise is wrong and should be corrected in follow-up.

findings.label: Optional parity extras omitted
findings.detail: Right-click-to-pause, double-click-to-play, and mouse-wheel zoom exist in the old bundle (one app-level wheel listener confirmed) but are not implemented. The plan explicitly marked these optional and not required for parity sign-off. Add later if wanted.

findings.label: Download-selection error handling softer than legacy
findings.detail: The old app re-threw on a failed /util/selection-export; the new handler catches, logs to console.error, and silently hides the wait message, leaving no user-visible error. Consider surfacing a user-facing error.

findings.label: StrictMode double-mounts the wavesurfer effect in dev
findings.detail: main.tsx wraps the app in <StrictMode>, double-invoking the create/destroy effect in development only. Cleanup calls ws.destroy() so no leak results, and StrictMode is stripped in production builds. Noted so it isn't mistaken for a leak.
